description: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next BF16 by Unsloth
gpu_tip: ~360GB total at 128K context — the unquantized build, and far beyond any single machine most people own. The hybrid design means context adds barely 6GB on top of the weights; the weights are the entire problem. Realistically this is a multi-GPU server or a 384GB+ workstation, not a desktop with an offload strategy.
mac_tip: Needs ~360GB — beyond every MacBook Pro and beyond a 192GB Mac Studio; only a 512GB M3 Ultra Mac Studio can hold it.
